name: stem-calc-student-mcp
description: STEM calculator MCP for chemistry and physics homework: molar mass, balancing equations, grams to moles, unit conversion and significant figures. Works offline, no account or API key.

tools.name: molar_mass
tools.description: Parse a chemical formula and return the molar mass in g/mol with the mass each element adds. Handles brackets and hydrates like CuSO4.5H2O.

parameters.name: formula
parameters.description: Chemical formula like H2O, Ca(OH)2 or CuSO4.5H2O. Write each element with a capital first letter.

tools.name: balance_equation
tools.description: Balance a chemical equation written with -> and +.

tools.name: stoichiometry
tools.description: Convert between grams, moles and particles. The formula is required whenever grams are the from or to unit. Converting between moles and particles needs no formula.

parameters.name: formula
parameters.description: The chemical formula, like H2O. Required when from or to is grams. Not used otherwise.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a value between units of length, mass, time, volume, energy, temperature, pressure, speed or flow rate. Common spellings like ml, degC, °C and L/min are accepted. It refuses to convert one kind of unit into another.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The unit it is in, like km, kg, mL, J or C.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The unit to convert it to.

tools.name: round_sig_figs
tools.description: Round a number to a given number of significant figures.

parameters.name: sigFigs
parameters.description: How many significant figures to keep.
